lines.text: Saturday morning, Bansal Apartment. Bathroom ke sheeshe par halki bhaap thi. Ankita ne nal band kiya. Garam paani ki aakhri boondein uske kandhon se neeche slide ho rahi thi. Kal Friday ka ek pal uske dimaag se nahi gaya — Chirag ka achanak paas aana, uske honthon ka garam, soft pressure, aur uska apne aap jawaab de dena.

Usne aankhen band kar li. Sab kuch itni jaldi hua tha ki us waqt samajhne ka mauka nahi mila. Lekin ab, ek raat baad, woh us moment ko baar-baar usi jagah se yaad kar rahi thi jahan dono ekdum chup ho gaye the. Uske honth abhi bhi thode se sensitive feel ho rahe the, jaise raat bhar us pressure ki yaad unpar chhap gayi ho.

Main peeche kyun nahi hati? Usne khud se poochha. Agla sawaal zyada mushkil tha. Aur maine use rokne ke bajay kiss wapas kyun kiya?

Uske pet ke neeche ek halki si garmi fail gayi — sharm aur kuch aur, jo woh abhi naam nahi dena chahti thi.

Woh sirf Chirag ko blame karke baat khatam nahi kar sakti thi. Woh 22 saal ka adult tha, aur Ankita bhi apni choices ki zimmedar thi. Friday ki ghabrahat ke beech yeh baat usse ab saaf dikh rahi thi. Usne towel se baal pochhe, lekin haath dheere the, jaise body abhi bhi us memory ke under ho.

Chirag ka darra hua chehra bhi yaad aaya — uske turant peeche hatne ka tareeka, aankhon mein woh sudden fear, phir Ankita ka jaldi se bedroom ki taraf chala jaana. Jaane se pehle usne jo kaha tha, usse yaad karke woh aur sharma gayi: I liked it.

Uske gaalon mein heat aa gayi. Mirror mein uski aankhen thodi si badi dikh rahi thi.

Kya main sach mein kehna chahti thi? Use laga jawab haan tha. Isi wajah se uske andar ek halka sa darr bhi uth raha tha. Jo baat kal bas kuch seconds ki thi, uska matlab aaj zyada bada lag raha tha. Usne towel ko chest par press kiya, jaise us pressure se soch ruk jayegi.

Usne towel achchhe se fold kiya, jaise ek bilkul ordinary kaam use wapas routine mein la sakta ho. Lekin towel rakhne ke baad bhi uske khayal wahi the. Skin abhi bhi thodi si alert thi — bathroom ki thandi hawa uske nange kandhon par padi to usne involuntarily shoulders ko andar kiya.

Tuesday ka documents wala encounter yaad aaya. Us din usne Chirag ka reaction samajhne ki koshish ki thi. Friday ko shelf ke paas jo hua, woh shuru mein normal kaam tha; phir nazron aur teasing ne dono ko ek alag hi mood mein la diya. Uske navel ke aas-paas ki skin yaad aa gayi — kaise top upar khisak gayi thi, kaise Chirag ki nazar wahan atak gayi thi.

Toh kya kal ka kiss wahi sab ka continuation tha? Ankita abhi is sawaal ka pakka jawab nahi de sakti thi. Chirag ne us moment ko kaise samjha hoga, yeh bhi usse pata nahi tha. Usne apne lower lip ko halka sa kaata — wohi lip jise kal Chirag ne touch kiya tha.

Bahar ghar ki roz ki awaazein aa rahi thi. Ankita ne darwaza khola aur ek pal ke liye ruk gayi. Uska ghar, uski shaadi, Rey ki chhoti-chhoti baatein — kuch bhi badla hua nahi lag raha tha. Badli hui cheez uske andar thi. Uske thighs ke beech halki si restless feeling abhi bhi thi, jo woh ignore karna chahti thi.

Ritvik ko Friday ki delivery ka pata hona koi badi baat nahi thi. Lekin us delivery ke baad kya hua, uske baare mein Ankita ne ek shabd bhi nahi kaha tha. Usne apne night-suit ke buttons check kiye, jaise koi secret body par likha ho.

Kya yeh cheating hai? Sawaal aaya, aur Ankita ne turant use dabaane ki koshish ki. Phir bhi use laga ki kisi cheez ko naam na dene se woh cheez gayab nahi ho jaati. Uske nipples towel ke neeche thode se tight feel ho rahe the — memory ka involuntary effect.

Usne khud ko yaad dilaya ki Chirag ne uski taraf dekha, woh uske saath hansi, aur kal ke aakhri pal mein woh bhi us kiss mein shaamil thi. Yeh ek one-sided incident ki simple kahani nahi thi. Usne apne aap ko mirror mein dekha — aankhon mein abhi bhi woh same soft, confused look tha jo kal Chirag ne dekha hoga.

Woh Ritvik ke saamne abhi is baat ko rakhne ke liye ready nahi thi. Iska matlab yeh nahi tha ki usne apne aap ko poori tarah maaf kar diya tha. Bas woh us subah confession ya explanation dono se bach rahi thi. Usne baal ko ek simple clip se sambhala, lekin haath thoda sa unstable tha.

Phone uthaya toh screen par normal notifications thi. Chirag ka koi message nahi. Ankita ne bina kuch type kiye phone wapas rakh diya. Koi nayi baat shuru karne ka faisla usne nahi kiya. Phir bhi uske thumb screen par thodi der ruk gaye the.

Thursday ko Karan aur Aman ke saamne jo embarrassing accident hua tha, woh bhi use yaad aaya. Monday shaam un dono ke saath freelance-project ka pehla proper review planned tha. Ab woh meeting ek aur wajah se awkward lag rahi thi. Usne socha — do alag men, do alag kinds of attention, aur uska ek hi body jo dono ke beech fas gaya tha.

Usne schedule yaad kiya — Monday, office ke baad, ek ghante ki project discussion. Karan usually aasan tareeke se baat sambhaal leta tha. Aman zyada chup rehta tha. Dono ka Thursday ko alag-alag reaction uske dimaag mein abhi bhi fresh tha. Karan ki surprised eyes, Aman ki turant hui nazar-hatana.

Main normal behave kar paungi? Is baar sawaal Chirag ke baare mein nahi, un dono colleagues ke baare mein tha. Ankita ne apne aap ko kaha ki kaam ka kaam alag hai, aur personal embarrassment ko us par haavi nahi hone dena chahiye. Usne deep breath li; chest ke upar towel ki pressure se uski breathing thodi control hui.

Woh kitchen ki taraf badhi. Abhi Saturday tha. Monday ki meeting aur Friday ki memory ke beech poora weekend pada tha, aur filhaal use apne ghar ki morning routine sambhaalni thi. Floor thanda tha uske bare feet ke neeche.

Lekin breakfast ki taiyaari karte hue bhi ek baat uske saath rahi: kal Chirag ke saamne woh apni reaction se khud surprised thi. Agli baar usse milne par kya kahegi, abhi use nahi pata tha. Uske fingers pan ke handle par tight the.

Usne apne khayalon ko ek taraf rakha aur routine mein laut aayi. Ritvik ko kiss ke baare mein kuch nahi bataya. Friday ka woh chhota sa raaz Saturday subah bhi uske paas hi raha — uske lips, uske body, aur uske unanswered questions ke saath.
